definitions.gloss: health management; health care; maintaining one's health
definitions.explanation: The practice of monitoring and maintaining one's physical and mental health through regular checkups, diet, exercise, and lifestyle choices.

examples.japanese: {健康管理|けんこうかんり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I pay attention to my health management.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健康管理|けんこうかんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I use an app to manage my daily health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健康管理|けんこうかんり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The company is putting effort into employee health management.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (health) + ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management). A widely used term in daily life, workplace contexts, and healthcare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健康管理|けんこうかんり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧: to pay attention to health management
- {健康管理|けんこうかんり}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: health management app
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健康管理|けんこうかんり}: employee health management
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健康管理|けんこうかんり}: daily health care
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{健康管理|けんこうかんり}: self-health management

USAGE:
Very common in corporate and institutional contexts, where companies have legal obligations regarding employee health. Also commonly used in personal contexts about maintaining one's own health through diet, exercise, and regular checkups.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧: health checkup, medical examination
- ⟦{体調管理|たいちょうかんり}→体調管理：15302_taichoukanri⟧: condition management — focuses on daily physical condition
